events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Zach Neto hit a three-run home run to lift the Los Angeles Angels over the Baltimore Orioles 4-1 in the final game of the series on Thursday afternoon.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zach Neto hits a three-run home run to lift the Angels over the Orioles 4-1

headlines.description: — Elly De La Cruz hit his fourth career leadoff home run — one of four homers by Cincinnati — and the Reds beat the Athletics 6-5 on Thursday afternoon to complete a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Reds homer four times to back Andrew Abbott, beat the Athletics 6-5 to complete sweep

events.name: New York Mets at Cleveland Guardians

headlines.description: — All-Star Foster Griffin struggled in his first start for the free-falling Cleveland Guardians, allowing five runs in four innings of a 13-6 loss to the Mets that gave last-place New York a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Griffin struggles in first start for Guardians, who lose 13-6 to Mets and fall out of wild-card spot

headlines.description: — Dustin May won his Milwaukee debut and Jackson Chourio and Gary Sánchez hit home runs as the Brewers defeated the Pittsburgh Pirates 5-2 on Thursday afternoon.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dustin May wins Milwaukee debut, Chourio and Sánchez homer as Brewers beat Pirates 5-2

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Chicago Cubs

headlines.description: — Pete Crow-Armstrong scored on a throwing error in the 11th inning after Alex Bregman hit a two-strike, two-out homer in the ninth, and the Chicago Cubs rallied for a 3-2 win over the Toronto Blue Jays on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pete Crow-Armstrong scores on error in 11th and Cubs rally for 3-2 win over Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Dillon Dingler homered for the third straight game and finished with three hits and three RBI as the Detroit Tigers defeated the Seattle Mariners 11-0 Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dingler homers for 3rd straight game, helping Tigers to an 11-0 win over the Mariners

headlines.description: — Cristopher Sanchez became the first 15-game winner in the majors this season, Bryson Stott had two of Philadelphia's eight doubles and the Phillies beat the Washington Nationals 7-3 on Thursday night for their fifth victory in six games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sanchez becomes first 15-game winner in majors in Phillies' 7-3 victory over Nationals

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Caleb Durbin lined a single to center field off Chicago’s Erick Fedde in the 13th inning to score NIck Sogard and the Boston Red Sox rallied to beat the Chicago White Sox 12-11 on Thursday night in a game that lasted more than four hours.
headlines.shortLinkText: Durbin’s RBI single in the 13th inning caps Red Sox's 12-11 win over the White Sox

headlines.description: — Ronald Acuña Jr. hit two home runs, including one assisted by Miami's defense, and Matt Olson added a blast as the Atlanta Braves beat the Marlins 11-3 to complete a three-game...
headlines.shortLinkText: Acuña hits 2 homers, Olson adds blast as Braves beat Marlins 11-3 for season-best 8th straight win

events.name: Minnesota Twins at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Brooks Lee's two-run single in the eighth inning lifted the Minnesota Twins to a 4-3 win over the Kansas City Royals on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brooks Lee's 2-run single in 8th lifts Twins to 4-3 win over Royals

events.name: San Diego Padres at Arizona Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Jackson Merrill and Ty France both had two hits and an RBI, four relievers combined for five scoreless innings and the San Diego Padres beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-1 on Thursday night to improve their position in the National League playoff race.
headlines.shortLinkText: Padres beat Diamondbacks 5-1 to close within a game in NL wild-card race
